football_evidence.question: Can Missouri win at the line of scrimmage?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.0 points.
supporting: In his last two games (Texas A&M and Ole Miss), Simmons averaged 6.8 yards per attempt, against 9.3 in his five games before that.
When Missouri has the ball (the red zone): Missouri’s offense succeeds on 27.7% of its red-zone plays, and Arkansas’ defense allows success on 54.9% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.6%).

When Missouri has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Missouri’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 20.2% of its runs, and Arkansas’ defense stops 12.7% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.5%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Arkansas’ receivers No. 14 nationally and Missouri’s No. 44.
contradicting: When Arkansas has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Arkansas’ offense has allowed a sack on 6.1% of its dropbacks, and Missouri’s defense sacks the quarterback on 7.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When Missouri has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Missouri’s offense has allowed a sack on 2.0% of its dropbacks, and Arkansas’ defense sacks the quarterback on 6.5% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When Missouri has the ball (big plays through the air): Missouri’s offense turns 14.0% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Arkansas’ defense gives up explosive gains on 11.4% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.2%).

When Arkansas has the ball (big plays through the air): Arkansas’ offense turns 10.0% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Missouri’s defense gives up explosive gains on 7.9% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.2%).
quarterbacks: KJ Jackson has completed 131 of 217 passes (60.4%) for 1,444 yards, 6.7 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in seven games for Arkansas, and has been sacked on 12 of 229 dropbacks.
AJ Hill has completed 16 of 28 passes (57.1%) for 181 yards, 6.5 yards per attempt, 1 touchdown and no interceptions in two games for Arkansas, and has been sacked on 4 of 32 dropbacks.

Austin Simmons has completed 132 of 209 passes (63.2%) for 1,756 yards, 8.4 yards per attempt, 14 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in seven games for Missouri, and has been sacked on 7 of 216 dropbacks.
